description: Turns local folders into customizable visual workspaces with widgets, annotations, and notes.

script: $html = & curl.exe --fail --location --silent --show-error --retry 2 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 45 --user-agent 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://deskboard.geeke.app/download'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to download the official Deskboard download page.' }
if ($text -notmatch '(?i)Windows') { throw 'The official Deskboard download page did not expose its Windows download section.' }
if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to detect the Deskboard release version from the official download page.' }
